1271: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ॥4॥2॥20॥
The Transcendent Lord has become merciful;
the cloud rains streams of nectar.
All beings and creatures are satisfied,
and their tasks are perfectly accomplished. ॥1॥
O mind, remember the Name forever and ever.
ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਐਥੈ ਓਥੈ ਨਿਬਹੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It is obtained by serving the perfect Guru, and it stays with you here and hereafter. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
The Destroyer of fear has shattered pain,
and taken care of His own beings.
be forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ॥2॥
The Creator Himself has removed death.
ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ; ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
O mind, meditate on Him forever and ever.
Casting His glance of grace, He has protected all beings.
Sing the praises of the Lord God, continually. ॥3॥
The One Creator is Himself all in all.
The Lord's devotees know His glory.
He has always upheld the honour of His Name.
Nanak speaks as He makes him speak. ॥4॥3॥21॥
In the Guru's sanctuary are all treasures,
and honour is obtained in the True Court.
ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ; ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
Doubt, fear, pain and suffering all depart,
singing the Lord's praises forever in the company of the holy. ॥1॥
O my mind, praise the perfect Guru.
ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ; ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Chant the Name, the treasure, day and night, and obtain the fruits of your heart's desires. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
No one else is as great as the true Guru;
the Guru is the Supreme Lord, the Transcendent Lord.
He saves one from the pain of birth and death,
ਮਾਇਆ ਬਿਖੁ; ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੨॥
and one does not taste the poison of Maya again. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਕਥਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
The Guru's glory cannot be described;
the Guru is the Transcendent Lord, absorbed in the True Name.
Truth is His self-discipline, and all His deeds are true.
ਸੋ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ; ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਚੀ ॥੩॥
That mind is pure which is absorbed in the Guru's company. ॥3॥
The perfect Guru is found by great good fortune;
ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਤਿਆਗਿ ॥
then one casts lust, anger and greed out of the mind.
In Your mercy, let me dwell at the Guru's feet;
this is Nanak's prayer to God, the True One. ॥4॥4॥22॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਗੁਰ ਮਨਾਰਿ; ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਦਇਆਰ ਸਿਉ. ਰੰਗੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
Winning the Guru's favour, she has enjoyed the love of her merciful Beloved.
She has adorned herself with every ornament,
and her wandering mind has become steady. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਐਸੇ ਰੇ. ਮਨ ਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ. ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
O mind, attain Him like this: shed your ego and keep company with the holy.
ਬਾਜੇ ਬਜਹਿ ਮ੍ਰਿਦੰਗ, ਅਨਾਹਦ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਰੀ; ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲੈ, ਮਧੁਰ ਬੈਨ ਅਤਿ ਸੁਹੀਆ ॥੧॥
The drums of the unstruck melody resound, and like a cuckoo the tongue utters the Lord's Name in sweet and lovely words. ॥1॥
ਐਸੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਭ, ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਅਮੋਘ; ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ, ਸੰਤ ਬਨੇ ॥
Such is the glory of Your sight, O infinite Beloved, unfailing; so too become the saints in Your company.
Chanting the Name that carries one across the world-ocean,
they tell the rosary of the Lord's Name
1272: in their minds, and become companions of the Lord.
Servant Nanak, the Beloved has become dear to them. ॥2॥1॥23॥
The mind wanders in the dense forest.
It moves on with eagerness and love,
ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਨ ਮਾਈ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਈ; ਕਹੰਉ ਬੇਦਨ ਕਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
Maya of the three qualities has come to entice me; to whom can I tell my pain? ॥1॥
ਆਨ ਉਪਾਵ ਸਗਰ ਕੀਏ; ਨਹਿ ਦੂਖ ਸਾਕਹਿ ਲਾਹਿ ॥
I have tried every other means, but none can take away my pain.
ਭਜੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਮਿਲੁ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦਹਿ ਗਾਹਿ ॥੨॥੨॥੨੪॥
Hasten to the sanctuary of the holy Guru, O Nanak, and meet the Lord, immersing yourself in the praises of the Lord of the universe. ॥2॥2॥24॥
The glory of the Beloved is lovely and sublime.
ਹਾਹਾ ਹੂਹੂ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਅਪਸਰਾ; ਅਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ, ਗਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It is as if Haha and Huhu, the gandharvas and the heavenly nymphs sing sweet songs of bliss and joy. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ ਗੁਨਗੵ. ਅਨਿਕ ਭਾਂਤਿ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੧॥
As if those versed in music sing graceful melodies in many ways, and show many lovely forms. ॥1॥
ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਥਲ ਜਲ, ਭਵਨ ਭਰਪੁਰਿ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਲਾਲਨ, ਛਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥
Mountains, trees, land, water and the worlds are filled with Him; in each and every heart the Beloved makes His lovely dwelling.
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਓ; ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਨੀਕੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੨੫॥
In the company of the holy one finds the Lord's sweet essence — Nanak, one whose faith is sincere. ॥2॥3॥25॥
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ; ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through love of the beloved Guru, I have enshrined the Lord's lotus feet within my heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਦਰਸੁ ਸਫਲਿਓ. ਦਰਸੁ ਪੇਖਿਓ; ਗਏ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਗਏ ॥
Fruitful is His sight; beholding it, all sins are gone,
and minds become pure and enlightened. ॥1॥
Wonder upon wonder — one is wonderstruck.
Millions of sins are taken away by chanting the Name.
Those who place their foreheads at the Guru's feet and fall before Him —
for them, O God, You alone, You alone are the support.
servant Nanak lies at Your door, in Your sanctuary. ॥2॥4॥26॥
Rain down joyfully, by His command,
that there may be bliss and all good fortune. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸੰਤ ਸੰਗੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਰਫੜੈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਮੇਘ ਧਰ ਸੁਹਾਗ ॥੧॥
In the company of the saints the mind blossoms, as the earth flourishes when it meets the rain-cloud. ॥1॥
As the peacock loves the thunder of the clouds,
and the rainbird's mind is turned towards the raindrop,
so let your mind be attached to the Lord.
and meeting the saint, Nanak has awakened. ॥2॥5॥27॥
Sing the praises of the Lord of the world continually.
Keep the Lord's Name in your mind. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਛੋਡਿ ਮਾਨੁ. ਤਜਿ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂਆ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
Abandon pride and give up arrogance, joining the company of the holy.
ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ; ਮਿਟਿ ਜਾਂਹਿ ਦੋਖ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
Meditate on the Lord in the love of the One, and your faults will be erased, O friend. ॥1॥
The Supreme Lord has become merciful,
and the entanglements of vice are destroyed,
for one who, attached to the feet of the holy,
sings continually of the Lord of the universe, O Nanak. ॥2॥6॥28॥
When the cloud thunders — the Guru, image of the Lord of the universe —
singing His praises brings peace and calm. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ. ਤਰਨ ਸਾਗਰ; ਧੁਨਿ ਅਨਹਤਾ ਰਸ ਬੈਨ ॥੧॥
The sanctuary of the Lord's feet is the boat across the ocean; His words carry the sweetness of the unstruck melody. ॥1॥
ਪਥਿਕ ਪਿਆਸ. ਚਿਤ ਸਰੋਵਰ; ਆਤਮ ਜਲੁ ਲੈਨ ॥
As the traveller's mind thirsts for the lake to drink its water, so the soul thirsts for the water of life.
ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ. ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੈਨ ॥੨॥੭॥੨੯॥
Servant Nanak longs lovingly for the Lord's sight; God in His mercy grants it. ॥2॥7॥29॥
1273: ਹੇ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਹੇ ਗੋਪਾਲ; ਹੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਲਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord of the universe, O Cherisher of the world, O merciful, beloved Lord! ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਨਾਥ ਅਨਾਥ ਸਖੇ; ਦੀਨ ਦਰਦ ਨਿਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
Master of my breath of life, Companion of the masterless, Remover of the pain of the meek! ॥1॥
ਹੇ ਸਮ੍ਰਥ ਅਗਮ ਪੂਰਨ; ਮੋਹਿ ਮਇਆ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
O all-powerful, inaccessible, all-pervading Lord, show me Your mercy. ॥2॥
ਅੰਧ ਕੂਪ ਮਹਾ ਭਇਆਨ; ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰ ॥੩॥੮॥੩੦॥
The world is a deep, dark and terrifying pit; carry Nanak across. ॥3॥8॥30॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਚਕਵੀ ਨੈਨ ਨਂ‍ੀਦ ਨਹਿ ਚਾਹੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਪਿਰ. ਨਂ‍ੀਦ, ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
The chakvi bird does not want sleep in her eyes; without her beloved she cannot sleep.
ਸੂਰੁ ਚਰ੍ਹੈ. ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਦੇਖੈ ਨੈਨੀ; ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
When the sun rises, she sees her beloved with her eyes, and bows down again and again at his feet. ॥1॥
The love of my Beloved, my companion, is pleasing to me.
ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਘੜੀ. ਨਹੀ ਜਗਿ ਜੀਵਾ; ਐਸੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਤਿਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Without Him I cannot live in the world even for a moment; such is the thirst I feel. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਰਵਰਿ ਕਮਲੁ ਕਿਰਣਿ ਆਕਾਸੀ; ਬਿਗਸੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥
The lotus is in the lake and the sun's ray in the sky, yet the lotus blossoms of its own accord.
ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਅਭ ਐਸੀ; ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੨॥
Such love for the Beloved wells up within that one's light merges in His Light. ॥2॥
ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕੁ. ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਟੇਰੈ; ਬਿਲਪ ਕਰੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਈ ॥
Without water the rainbird cries "Beloved, Beloved!", wailing and lamenting.
ਘਨਹਰ ਘੋਰ ਦਸੌ ਦਿਸਿ ਬਰਸੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪਿਆਸ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
The thundering clouds rain in all ten directions, but without that one drop its thirst does not go. ॥3॥
ਮੀਨ ਨਿਵਾਸ ਉਪਜੈ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ; ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
The fish is born in water and lives in it; it finds pleasure and pain there according to its past deeds.
ਖਿਨੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਪਲੁ. ਜਲ ਬਿਨੁ; ਮਰਨੁ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਾਂਈ ॥੪॥
It cannot survive without water for an instant, a moment; its life and death depend on it. ॥4॥
ਧਨ ਵਾਂਢੀ. ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਸ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ; ਸਚੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਠਾਈਁ ॥
The bride is separated, though her Husband dwells in her own land; she sends her message through the true Guru.
ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ; ਭਗਤਿ ਰਤੀ ਹਰਖਾਈ ॥੫॥
Gathering virtues, she finds God dwelling in her heart; imbued with devotion, she rejoices. ॥5॥
ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਕਰੈ ਸਭੈ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੀ; ਗੁਰ ਭਾਵੈ. ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਪਾਈਁ ॥
Everyone cries "Beloved, Beloved!", but she who pleases the Guru finds the Beloved.
ਪ੍ਰਿਉ ਨਾਲੇ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਸੰਗੇ; ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
The Beloved is always with us, the True One; by His glance of grace He unites us in union. ॥6॥
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ. ਜੀਉ ਜੀਉ ਹੈ ਸੋਈ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
He is the life of the life of all; He pervades each and every heart.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ; ਸਹਜੇ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੭॥
By the Guru's grace He is revealed within one's own home, and one merges in intuitive poise. ॥7॥
ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਜੁ ਸਵਾਰਹੁ ਆਪੇ; ਸੁਖਦਾਤੇ ਗੋਸਾਂਈਁ ॥
Bring Your own task to completion Yourself, O Lord of the world, Giver of peace.
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਪਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੮॥੧॥
By the Guru's grace she has found her Husband within her own home; then, Nanak, her burning is quenched. ॥8॥1॥
ਜਾਗਤੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਰਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ; ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ. ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
One who stays awake and aware in the Guru's service lives well; apart from the Lord, this "I" is nothing.
ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਣੁ. ਨ ਪਾਵੈ; ਆਚੁ ਕਾਚੁ ਢਰਿ ਪਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
Despite countless efforts, the body cannot remain; it melts away like glass in the fire. ॥1॥
ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਧਨ ਕਾ; ਕਹਹੁ ਗਰਬੁ ਕੈਸਾ ॥
Tell me, why be proud of this body and wealth?
ਬਿਨਸਤ ਬਾਰ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਬਵਰੇ; ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬਿ ਖਪੈ ਜਗੁ ਐਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
It takes no time for them to perish, O madman; the world wastes away in ego and pride. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਜੈ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਖਵਾਰੇ; ਰਾਖੈ ਪਰਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
Victory to You, O Lord of the world, God, Protector; He alone protects and assesses all.
ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ. ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ; ਤੁਮੑ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥
All that is begs from You alone; there is no other equal to You. ॥2॥
ਜੀਅ ਉਪਾਇ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੀ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਜਨੁ ॥
Creating beings, He keeps the way of their lives under His control; He Himself gives the ointment of wisdom through the Guru.
ਅਮਰੁ ਅਨਾਥ, ਸਰਬ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੋਰਾ; ਕਾਲ ਬਿਕਾਲ ਭਰਮ ਭੈ ਖੰਜਨੁ ॥੩॥
My Lord is eternal, with no master over Him, over the heads of all; He destroys death and birth, doubt and fear. ॥3॥
1274: ਕਾਗਦ ਕੋਟੁ. ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਬਪੁਰੋ; ਰੰਗਨਿ ਚਿਹਨ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
This poor world is a fortress of paper, decorated with colour and design by His skill.
ਨਾਨੑੀ ਸੀ ਬੂੰਦ. ਪਵਨੁ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਵੈ; ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰੈ ਖਿਨੁ ਤਾਈਁ ॥੪॥
A tiny drop of water or a gust of wind destroys its glory; it is born and dies in an instant. ॥4॥
ਨਦੀ ਉਪਕੰਠਿ, ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰੁ. ਤਰਵਰੁ; ਸਰਪਨਿ ਘਰੁ. ਘਰ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
Like a house or a tree on a riverbank, or a snake's den within one's home —
ਉਲਟੀ ਨਦੀ. ਕਹਾਂ ਘਰੁ ਤਰਵਰੁ; ਸਰਪਨਿ ਡਸੈ. ਦੂਜਾ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੫॥
when the river turns, where is the house or the tree? The snake bites; so too with duality in the mind. ॥5॥
ਗਾਰੁੜ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ. ਧਿਆਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ; ਬਿਖਿਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਜਾਰੀ ॥
The Guru's wisdom and meditation on the Guru's words are the snake-charmer's spell; through the Guru's teaching the poison of Maya is burnt away.
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਹੇਂਵ ਭਏ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਿਰਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
Mind and body become cool as ice, and the True One is found; wondrous is devotion to the Lord. ॥6॥
ਜੇਤੀ ਹੈ. ਤੇਤੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਜਾਚੈ; ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆਂ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
All that is begs from You; You are merciful to all beings.
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੇ. ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ; ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥੭॥
I have come to Your sanctuary; save my honour, O Lord of the world, that I may find the True One. ॥7॥
ਬਾਧੀ ਧੰਧਿ ਅੰਧ. ਨਹੀ ਸੂਝੈ; ਬਧਿਕ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Bound by worldly affairs, the blind do not understand; they act like hunters.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੈ. ਤ ਸੂਝਸਿ ਬੂਝਸਿ; ਸਚ ਮਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੮॥
If one meets the true Guru, one understands and comprehends, and wisdom of the True One fills the mind. ॥8॥
ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਦੇਹ. ਸਾਚ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾਚੀ; ਮੈ ਪੂਛਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
Without the True One the body is worthless and frail; I ask my Guru about it.
ਨਾਨਕ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ. ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਚੇ. ਜਗੁ ਸੁਪਨਾ ॥੯॥੨॥
Nanak, He shows God, the Lord; without the True One the world is a dream. ॥9॥2॥
ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੀਨ ਜਲ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥
The rainbird and the fish find peace in water; the deer is delighted by sound. ॥1॥
ਰੈਨਿ ਬਬੀਹਾ ਬੋਲਿਓ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the night the rainbird cried out, O my mother. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ, ਨ ਉਲਟੈ ਕਬਹੂ; ਜੋ ਤੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
Their love for their beloved never turns away; whatever pleases You, Lord, comes to pass. ॥2॥
ਨੀਦ ਗਈ. ਹਉਮੈ ਤਨਿ ਥਾਕੀ; ਸਚ ਮਤਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੩॥
My sleep is gone, and the ego in my body is worn out; true understanding has filled my heart. ॥3॥
ਰੂਖਂ‍ੀ ਬਿਰਖਂ‍ੀ, ਊਡਉ ਭੂਖਾ; ਪੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਭਾਈ ॥੪॥
Flying from tree to tree I stay hungry; drinking the Name with love, I am satisfied. ॥4॥
ਲੋਚਨ ਤਾਰ ਲਲਤਾ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ; ਦਰਸਨ ਪਿਆਸ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੫॥
My eyes stare, and my tongue cries out, thirsting for the sight of the Lord of the divine will. ॥5॥
ਪ੍ਰਿਅ ਬਿਨੁ. ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਕਰੀ. ਤੇਤਾ ਤਨੁ ਤਾਪੈ; ਕਾਪਰੁ ਅੰਗਿ. ਨ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥੬॥
Without my Beloved, the more I adorn myself, the more my body burns; no clothes look good on my body. ॥6॥
ਅਪਨੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਨੁ. ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ, ਨ ਸਕਂਉ; ਬਿਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਨਂ‍ੀਦ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੭॥
Without my Beloved I cannot live even for an instant; without meeting Him I cannot sleep. ॥7॥
ਪਿਰੁ ਨਜੀਕਿ. ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਬਪੁੜੀ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੮॥
Her Husband is near, but the wretched one does not know it; the true Guru has shown Him. ॥8॥
ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੯॥
When she met Him in poise, she found peace; the Word has quenched her thirst. ॥9॥
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ; ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਨੁ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧੦॥੩॥
Says Nanak, through You my mind is satisfied; its worth cannot be told. ॥10॥3॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
The bird flies high in the sky, but the water is down in the sea.
The mountain path climbs high, but the fortress lies below.
Reflecting on the Guru's Word, the ocean becomes cool;
subduing ego, the path becomes open. ॥1॥
I am blind; the Name is my light.
ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ; ਚਲਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ ਭੇਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
With the Name as my support I walk in the Guru's fear, guided by His secret. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
1275: Through the true Guru's Word one recognises the level path,
walking with the Guru's support and the strength of the True One.
One keeps the Name in mind through the Guru's beautiful bani,
and if it pleases You, finds and recognises Your door. ॥2॥
Flying or sitting, I am lovingly attuned to the One,
with the Name as my support through the Guru's Word.
ਨਾ ਜਲੁ ਡੂੰਗਰੁ; ਨ ਊਚੀ ਧਾਰ ॥
There is no water, no mountain, no high ridge in the way.
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ; ਤਹ ਮਗੁ. ਨ ਚਾਲਣਹਾਰ ॥੩॥
I dwell in my own true home, where there is no path to travel and no traveller. ॥3॥
ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ. ਤੂਹੈ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣਹਿ; ਬੀਜਉ ਮਹਲੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
You alone know the state of the one in whose heart You dwell; no other place appears to him.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਸਮਝ. ਨ ਹੋਵੀ; ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਦਬਿਆ ਛਾਪੈ ॥
Without the true Guru there is no understanding; the whole world is crushed under its own weight.
ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਵ ਕਰੈ. ਬਿਲਲਾਤਉ; ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ. ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
People struggle and wail, but without the Guru the Name is not known.
ਪਲ ਪੰਕਜ ਮਹਿ. ਨਾਮੁ ਛਡਾਏ; ਜੇ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ॥੪॥
In the blink of an eye the Name sets one free, if one recognises the Guru's Word. ॥4॥
Some are foolish, blind, stupid and ignorant;
ਇਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭੈ; ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰ ॥
some, in the fear of the true Guru, take the Name as their support.
Sweet is the True bani, a stream of nectar;
whoever drinks it finds the door of liberation. ॥5॥
ਨਾਮੁ ਭੈ ਭਾਇ. ਰਿਦੈ ਵਸਾਹੀ; ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
Those who enshrine the Name in their hearts with fear and love do the Guru's work and utter the True bani.
ਇੰਦੁ ਵਰਸੈ ਧਰਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
Upon them the cloud rains, the earth of the heart becomes beautiful, and they see His light in each and every heart.
ਕਾਲਰਿ ਬੀਜਸਿ. ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਐਸੀ; ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕੀ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ ॥
The sign of one without a Guru is such evil-mindedness that he sows seed in barren, salty soil.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ. ਘੋਰ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ; ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ. ਬਿਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ ॥੬॥
Without the true Guru there is pitch darkness; without water, people drown and die. ॥6॥
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ; ਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
Whatever He does is by God's will.
ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ; ਸੁ ਮੇਟਣਾ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
What is written from the beginning cannot be erased.
Bound by His command, each one does his work.
One absorbed in the Word of the One merges in the True One. ॥7॥
ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ; ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸਿ ਨਾਮ ਪਤਾਲੰ ॥
Your command prevails in all four directions, O God; Your Name pervades the four directions and the nether worlds.
ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚਾ; ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਬੈਆਲੰ ॥
The True Word of God pervades all; by His grace the eternal Lord is met.
ਜਾਂਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਊਭੌ; ਖੁਧਿਆ ਨਿਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਾਲੰ ॥
Birth and death hover over the heads of all, with hunger, sleep and death.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸਾਚੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਰਸਾਲੰ ॥੮॥੧॥੪॥
Nanak, one who is blessed with the True glance of the Source of all delight obtains the Name, and it pleases his mind. ॥8॥1॥4॥
ਮਰਣ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਗਤਿ ਸਾਰ; ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
The soul does not know the worth of liberation from death, or of the high state.
Sitting at the edge, it tries to recognise the Guru's Word. ॥1॥
O bird, how have you been caught in the net?
ਅਲਖੁ. ਨ ਜਾਚਹਿ; ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮੑਾਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You do not beg from the unseen Lord, keeping Him in your heart. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
For the sake of one life you devour many lives.
Swimming in the water, you drown in the water. ॥2॥
when you are caught, then you regret. ॥3॥
ਜਬ ਗਲਿ ਫਾਸ ਪੜੀ; ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
When the heavy noose falls around your neck,
you cannot fly away, though you spread your wings. ॥4॥
O foolish self-willed one, you peck at the bait with relish.
Caught, you can be freed only by reflecting on His virtues and on divine wisdom. ॥5॥
Serve the true Guru, and the noose of death will be broken.
Keep the True Word in your heart. ॥6॥
The Guru's teaching is true; the Word is excellent.
ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ; ਰਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੭॥
It keeps the Lord's Name enshrined in the heart. ॥7॥
ਸੇ ਦੁਖ ਆਗੈ; ਜਿ ਭੋਗ ਬਿਲਾਸੇ ॥
The pleasures one enjoys here become pains hereafter.
ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਹੀ; ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਸਾਚੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੫॥
Nanak, there is no liberation without the True Name. ॥8॥2॥5॥
1276: Malar · Ashtpadis · Guru Amar Das · Ghar 1
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ. ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਪਾਇਆ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
When there is His grace, the true Guru is found; without His grace He cannot be found.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਐ. ਕੰਚਨੁ ਹੋਈਐ; ਜਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਹੋਇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
Meeting the true Guru one becomes pure gold, when it is the Lord's will. ॥1॥
ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
O my mind, fix your consciousness on the Name of the Lord.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Through the true Guru the True Lord is found, and one remains merged in the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਗਿਆਨੁ ਊਪਜੈ; ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
When wisdom wells up through the true Guru, this doubt departs.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ. ਹਰਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨੀ. ਨਹ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
Through the true Guru the Lord is understood, and one does not enter the womb again. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤ ਮਰੈ; ਮਰਿ ਜੀਵੈ. ਸਬਦੁ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
By the Guru's grace one dies while yet alive, and dying, lives again, practising the Word.
ਮੁਕਤਿ ਦੁਆਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਏ; ਜਿ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੩॥
He alone finds the door of liberation who sheds ego from within. ॥3॥
ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ. ਸਿਵ ਘਰਿ ਜੰਮੈ; ਵਿਚਹੁ ਸਕਤਿ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
By the Guru's grace one is reborn in the Lord's home, casting out the power of Maya from within.
ਅਚਰੁ ਚਰੈ. ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਾਏ; ਪੁਰਖੈ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
He subdues the unruly mind, gains discerning intellect, and through the Guru-Being meets the Primal Being. ॥4॥
ਧਾਤੁਰ ਬਾਜੀ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਹੈ; ਚਲੈ ਮੂਲੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
The world is a passing play; the thoughtless one departs having lost even his capital.
ਲਾਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ; ਕਰਮੀ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
The profit of the Lord is found in the true congregation; by His grace it comes into one's lap. ॥5॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਵਿਣੁ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ; ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
No one has found Him without the true Guru; reflect in your mind and heart and see.
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਭਵਜਲੁ ਉਤਰੇ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੬॥
By great fortune one finds the Guru and crosses the terrifying world-ocean. ॥6॥
ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾਂ. ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
The Lord's Name is my anchor; the Name of the Lord is my support.
ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ. ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਪਾਵਉ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੭॥
Have mercy, dear Lord, and unite me with the Guru, that I may find the door of liberation. ॥7॥
ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ; ਮੇਟਣਾ. ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
What the Master has written on the forehead from the beginning cannot be erased.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ; ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਣਾ ਭਾਇ ॥੮॥੧॥
Nanak, those humble beings to whom the Lord's will is pleasing become perfect. ॥8॥1॥
ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਗੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ; ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
The world is absorbed in the words of the Vedas, reflecting on the three qualities.
ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ. ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਸਹੈ; ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮੈ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
Without the Name, it suffers death's punishment, and dies to be reborn again and again.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਹੋਇ; ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
Meeting the true Guru one is liberated, and finds the door of liberation. ॥1॥
O mind, serve the true Guru and merge in the Lord.
ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
By great fortune one finds the perfect Guru, and meditates on the Name of the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao ॥
ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਉਪਾਈ; ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥
By His own will the Lord created the world; the Lord Himself gives support.
ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਕੀਆ; ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
By His own will the Lord made the mind pure, and it fell in love with the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਆ; ਸਭੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
By the Lord's will one meets the true Guru, who embellishes one's whole life. ॥2॥
ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਤਿ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
Wondrous, wondrous is the True bani; rare is the one who, through the Guru, understands it.
ਵਾਹੁ ਵਾਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ; ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
Saying "Wondrous, wondrous!", praise God; there is no other as great as He.
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਏ; ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
He Himself forgives and unites with Himself; by His grace He is attained. ॥3॥
ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮਾਹਰੋ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
The True Lord is the supreme Master; the true Guru has revealed Him.
ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵਰਸੈ. ਮਨੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਐ; ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
Nectar rains down, the mind is contented, and one stays lovingly attuned to the True One.
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਦਾ ਹਰੀਆਵਲੀ; ਫਿਰਿ. ਸੁਕੈ ਨਾ ਕੁਮਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
Through the Lord's Name one remains forever green; one does not dry up or wither again. ॥4॥
1277: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ. ਨ ਪਾਇਓ; ਮਨਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਪਤੀਆਇ ॥
No one has found Him without the true Guru; anyone may be convinced of this in the mind and see.
ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ. ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਭੇਟੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
By the Lord's grace the true Guru is found, and one meets Him in poise and love.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ; ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥੫॥
The self-willed are led astray by doubt; without good fortune the wealth of the Lord is not obtained. ॥5॥

such a woman is called glorious. ॥3॥

without meeting the Guru there is no liberation. ॥4॥

and, Nanak, one merges in the Truest of the True. ॥8॥1॥3॥5॥8॥

The Lord of the world, treasure of virtues, is ever with us; all virtues belong to the Lord of the universe.

Nanak, the Beloved is ever merciful; rare is the one among millions who knows Him. ॥1॥
O Beloved, Your state is inaccessible and infinite.

Purifier of sinners, Lover of devotion, ocean of mercy, O Master —

Those who wandered through millions of births and species were carried across by remembering the Name.

ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ; ਅਵਰਿ ਕਰੇਂਦਾ ਵੰਨ ॥
Bending low, the cloud comes, showing many colours.
ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ. ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਹ ਸਿਉ; ਕੇਵ ਰਹਸੀ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
How can I know whether my love for that Banker will last?
ਰੰਗੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਜਿਨੑ ਮਨਿ. ਭਉ ਭਾਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
The love of those brides lasts in whose minds there is His fear and love.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਾਹਰੀ; ਤਿਨ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ. ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
Nanak, those without fear and love find no peace in their bodies. ॥1॥
ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ; ਵਰਸੈ ਨੀਰੁ ਨਿਪੰਗੁ ॥
Bending low, the cloud comes, and pure water rains down.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾਮਣੀ; ਜਿਨੑ ਕੰਤੈ ਸਿਉ ਮਨਿ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak, pain afflicts those brides whose minds are estranged from their Husband Lord. ॥2॥
Creating both sides, the One pervades them.
ਬੇਦ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਰਤਾਇ; ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਾਦੁ ਘਤਿਆ ॥
Spreading the words of the Vedas, He placed conflict within.
ਪਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਨਿਰਵਿਰਤਿ ਹਾਠਾ ਦੋਵੈ; ਵਿਚਿ ਧਰਮੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਰੈਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
Worldly involvement and detachment are both His supports; righteousness moves between them as the go-between.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਚੇ ਕੂੜਿਆਰ; ਤਿਨੑੀ ਨਿਹਚਉ ਦਰਗਹ ਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
The self-willed are immature and false; they surely lose in the Lord's Court.
ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੂਰ ਹੈ; ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Those who follow the Guru's teaching are heroes through the Word; they have conquered lust and anger.
They are embellished by the Word within the True Mansion.
ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵਦੇ; ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
Those devotees are pleasing to You, who love the True Name.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਨਿ ਆਪਣਾ; ਤਿਨੑਾ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੫॥
I am a sacrifice to those who serve their true Guru. ॥5॥
ਊਂਨਵਿ ਊਂਨਵਿ ਆਇਆ; ਵਰਸੈ ਲਾਇ ਝੜੀ ॥
Bending low, the cloud comes and rains in torrents.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਕੰਤ ਕੈ; ਸੁ ਮਾਣੇ ਸਦਾ ਰਲੀ ॥੧॥
Nanak, she who walks in the will of her Husband Lord enjoys bliss forever. ॥1॥
ਕਿਆ ਉਠਿ ਉਠਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬਪੁੜੇਂ; ਇਸੁ ਮੇਘੈ ਹਥਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Why do you keep getting up to look, you wretched people? Nothing is in the hands of this cloud.
ਜਿਨਿ ਏਹੁ ਮੇਘੁ ਪਠਾਇਆ; ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਂਹਿ ॥
Keep in your mind the One who sent this cloud.
ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਇਸੀ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
He alone enshrines Him in the mind on whom He casts His glance of grace.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਨਦਰੀ ਬਾਹਰੀ; ਸਭ ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੨॥
Nanak, without His glance of grace all struggle and cry out. ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਸਰੇਵੀਐ; ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਤ. ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਾਰ ॥
Serve forever the Lord who takes no time to create.
ਆਡਾਣੇ ਆਕਾਸ ਕਰਿ; ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਢਾਹਿ ਉਸਾਰਣਹਾਰ ॥
He spread out the skies, and in an instant can demolish and rebuild them.
ਆਪੇ ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਕੈ; ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰ ॥
Creating the world Himself, He contemplates His creation.
ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗੈ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗੀਐ; ਬਹੁਤੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਾਰ ॥
The self-willed are called to account hereafter, and are severely punished.
